run_main_menu: run the main.py entry point to access the menu-driven interface for YouTube, Twitter, affiliate marketing, and outreach
create_youtube_video: create a YouTube video by generating a script, synthesizing audio with TTS, and assembling video with MoviePy
upload_youtube_video: upload a generated YouTube video and optionally cross-post as a YouTube Short via Post Bridge
schedule_youtube_upload: schedule a YouTube video upload job using the schedule library with once-daily or twice-daily frequency
run_twitter_bot: run the Twitter bot to post tweets generated by LLM and list previously posted tweets
schedule_twitter_posts: schedule Twitter posts using the schedule library with once, twice, or thrice-daily frequency
generate_affiliate_pitch: generate an affiliate marketing pitch using LLM and share it via a linked Twitter account
synthesize_text_to_speech: synthesize text into audio WAV files using the KittenTTS model for video narration
